grammar.summary: 本课以作者在港口与商贩讨价还价的经历为线索，重点运用了 no sooner...than 与 hardly...when 时间状语、as if 方式状语从句以及分词短语作伴随状语。体会作者如何用 no sooner...than 强调刚下船就被缠上、用 as if 描写商贩的夸张反应、用分词短语使动作描写生动。

points.title: no sooner...than / hardly...when 时间状语 (Time Clause)
points.explanation: no sooner...than 与 hardly...when 表「刚……就……」，主句动作先于 than/when 从句。no sooner/hardily 置于句首时主句需部分倒装。本课用 I had no sooner got off the ship than I was assailed 强调「刚下船就被缠上」的猝不及防。

examples.en: I had no sooner got off the ship than I was assailed by a man who wanted to sell me a diamond ring.
examples.cn: 我刚下船，就被一个人截住，他向我兜售一枚钻石戒指。

points.title: as if 方式状语从句 (as if Clause)
points.explanation: as if 引导方式状语从句，表「仿佛、好像」，所述可为真实或虚拟。本课用 as if he found my offer outrageous 描写商贩「仿佛觉得我的出价令人不能容忍」，刻画其夸张做作的反应。

examples.en: Gesticulating wildly, the man acted as if he found my offer outrageous, but he eventually reduced the price to $10.
examples.cn: 那人激动地打着手势，仿佛我的出价使他不能容忍。但他终于把价钱降到了10英镑。

points.title: 分词短语作伴随状语 (Participle as Adverbial)
points.explanation: 现在分词短语可作伴随状语，逻辑主语与句子主语一致。本课用 Gesticulating wildly、Shrugging my shoulders 描写商贩与作者的动作，使讨价还价的场面跃然纸上。

examples.en: Gesticulating wildly, the man acted as if he found my offer outrageous...
examples.cn: 那人激动地打着手势，仿佛我的出价使他不能容忍……

examples.en: Shrugging my shoulders, I began to walk away when, a moment later, he ran after me and thrust the pen into my hands.
examples.cn: 我耸耸肩膀掉头走开了。一会儿，他突然从后追了上来，把笔塞到我手里。

exercises.q: I had no sooner got off the ship ______ I was assailed by a man who wanted to sell me a diamond ring.
the man acted ______ he found my offer outrageous, but he eventually reduced the price to $10.
______ wildly, the man acted as if he found my offer outrageous.（用分词作伴随状语）
用动词的适当形式填空：Many of the tourists on board had begun ______ (bargain) with the tradesmen, but I decide not to buy anything until I had disembarked.
课文中 The man went to great lengths to prove that the diamonds were real 的 went to great lengths 意思是？
